title.zh: Meta 推出企业 AI 平台并聘请 MongoDB CEO 领导
title.en: Meta launches enterprise AI platform and hires MongoDB CEO to lead it

current_state.zh: Meta announced the creation of Meta Enterprise Platform to bring its existing AI stack (Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code) to enterprises and developers, and hired MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead it, sending MongoDB shares down about 18% intraday.
current_state.en: Meta announced the creation of Meta Enterprise Platform to bring its existing AI stack (Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code) to enterprises and developers, and hired MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead it, sending MongoDB shares down about 18% intraday.
